title: Rocket
creator: CrossFit
description: A 30-minute AMRAP of a 50-yard swim, 10 push-ups and 15 squats. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Sgt. 1st Class Aaron 'Rocket' Henderson, who died of IED wounds at Bagram, Afghanistan, in 2012. A pool workout; do it in a 25 m pool as a length out and back.
